gen-fs-new-title-gf-montaga: Montaga reads like a classic serif with stitched, thread-like curves that stop just short of closing their loops. Over a full page, it keeps an editorial, bookish hum, while New Title stands tall above it.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-new-tegomin: Tall and chain-linked, New Title hits with a bold, modern snap. New Tegomin follows with a wide ring of a c, dignified and traditional, so a long passage would feel unhurried.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-podkova: Podkova reads as a bookish text serif, with a broad, welcoming c that feels traditional. Beside it, New Title looks tall and bold, its lowercase stretching higher while the body sits moderate and settled.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-rhodium-libre: New Title brings bold, modern lettering whose tall lowercase locks together like links in a fine chain. And Rhodium Libre, a traditional text serif with brush ends lifted before each curve closes, gives the page its editorial footing.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-rokkitt: Rokkitt is a bookish text serif, with a c as open as a bent paperclip. New Title does the loud, tall, chain-linked work up front, while Rokkitt handles the quieter job of carrying the text.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-sanchez: Tall, chain-linked and bold, New Title towers over Sanchez, a dignified classic serif whose c opens like calipers. Heading font grabs attention; Sanchez does the bookish work.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-solway: Authoritative and bookish, Solway is a classic serif with a generous entry into the e's eye. Solway would carry a long passage with steady, flat-weighted confidence, while New Title's tall lowercase stays on top.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-yuji-boku: Chain-linked, tall and bold, New Title is the look; Yuji Boku sits below as a dignified serif with a wide-open, bracelet-like c. New Title grabs the eye; Yuji Boku holds it with cable-like strokes.
gen-fs-new-title-nunito-sans: Bold and modern, New Title stretches its lowercase tall, each letter locked to the next like a fine chain. Nunito Sans, soft with open-mouthed curves in the small letters, takes over where big, short headings end.
gen-fs-nippo-fs-bespoke-slab: Nippo's small letters stand proud, nearly capital-sized, drawn in a constant marker-like line that looks cut from wire. Bespoke Slab, a grounded classic serif with tall-bodied lowercase, reads with refined steadiness.
